name: MADE 1.0
description: A shared task/benchmark for extracting medications, indications, and adverse drug events from electronic health record clinical notes.
reputation: A well-known shared-task dataset in clinical NLP that has been used by the medical NLP community for benchmarking medication and adverse event extraction systems.
notes: Clinical notes are domain-specific and PHI-sensitive; dataset sizes are moderate and models risk overfitting. Primarily used for traditional NLP and specialized clinical models; possible contamination if clinical corpora overlap with model pretraining data.
